description: This file defines a custom exception class `ThingNotModifiableException`, used to indicate that a Thing or its component could not be modified due to insufficient permissions. The class includes builder pattern methods, JSON parsing support, and integration with the Ditto framework's exception handling infrastructure.

classes.name: ThingNotModifiableException
classes.description: Custom exception indicating a Thing could not be modified due to authorization issues. Extends DittoRuntimeException and implements ThingException, with support for JSON serialization/deserialization and a builder pattern.

classes.name: Builder
classes.description: A mutable builder class for constructing instances of ThingNotModifiableException with a fluent API, allowing setting of message, description, cause, href, and headers.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new builder instance initialized with the specified ThingId.

methods.name: fromMessage
methods.description: Constructs an exception instance from a provided message string and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Constructs an exception instance by parsing a JSON object and attaching headers.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Creates a new exception instance with updated headers, preserving other properties.
